releases.name: v0.2.0 Improved API
releases.body: - Split up the API into multiple methods so it'll be easier to extend in the future

releases.name: v0.1.0 Initial release
releases.body:
- A localization utility mod. Allows for easily replacing English with another language using an XML file.
- Supports using a different font using a Unity asset bundle (required for non-Latin alphabet languages).
- Supports using a "fixer" function to fix written characters in a string (required for right-to-left languages like Arabic).
- Only allows one add-on at a time currently, will allow for language selection in the future
